# Zoom Through

**Motion › Zoom** · v1.0.0 · 30 frames at 30 fps (14–60)

A circle in the new background colour opens on the old scene and the camera rushes into it; it fills the frame and the new scene lands.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/zoom-through@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Diving into a detail
- Energetic intros
- Music videos

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import zoomThrough from './transitions/05-motion/zoom/zoom-through';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(zoomThrough, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 30 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | color | `"#FF4F1A"` |  | The incoming scene's background colour; the transition brings it in. |
| `x` | number | `0.5` | 0–1 | Where the circle opens, x (0..1). |
| `y` | number | `0.5` | 0–1 | Where the circle opens, y (0..1). |
| `amount` | number | `3` | 1.5–8 | How far the old scene zooms in. |
| `blur` | number | `14` | 0–40 | Peak blur in pixels. |
